description.en: Image integrity checks for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency 8-bit PNG decoding with block fingerprints and NCC confirmation to find duplicated or mirrored regions within or across figures, plus REP evidence and Markdown/SARIF reports.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的图像完整性检查：零依赖 8-bit PNG 解码，用块指纹与 NCC 确认查找同一图内或两图之间重复/镜像的区域，并输出 REP 证据与 Markdown/SARIF 报告。
